questions.question: The efficiency of A is thrice as that of B and efficiency of B is twice as that of C. If B alone can finish a work in 15 days, in how many days A and C together will complete that work?
questions.solution:
Let the efficiency of C be x, then

Efficiency of B = x × 2 = 2x

Efficiency of A = 2x × 3 = 6x

Efficiency ratio of A, B and C = x ∶ 2x ∶ 6x = 1 ∶ 2 ∶ 6

Total work = 2 × 15 = 30

A and C together will complete the whole work in = 30/(1 + 6) = 30/7 = 4(2)/(7)

questions.question: The number 30744 is divisible by which of the single digit numbers∶
questions.solution:
Divisibility law of 2 ⇒ A number divisible by 2 if its last digit is 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8.

Divisibility law of 3 ⇒ A number divisible by 3, if the sum of its digit is divisible by 3

Divisibility laws of 4 ⇒ A number divisible by 4, if its last 2 digit divisible by 4.

Divisibility law of 5 ⇒ A number divisible by 5 if its last digit is 0 or 5

Divisibility law of 6 ⇒ A number divisible by 6 if the number divisible by 2 and 3 both.

Divisibility law of 7 ⇒ Take the last digit of the number, double it Then subtract the result from the rest of the number If the resulting number is evenly divisible by 7, so is the original number divisible by 7.

Divisibility law of 8 ⇒ A number divisible by 8 if its last three digit is divisible by 8

Divisibility law of 9 ⇒ A number is divisible by 9 if sum of its digit is divisible by 9.

From the divisibility law of 2, 3, 4, 6, 7,8 and 9 the number 30744 divisible except 5.
